# memolki

> Logic Memo and Memory Game — Effective Brain Training for the Whole Family

memolki is an Android memory card game by Tabula Games Studio. It's the perfect entertainment for everyone, regardless of age — a tool that supports cognitive development and a great alternative for relaxation.

Unlike simple matching games, memolki uses association challenges: match a banana with its cross-section, a lion from the front with its side view, or a duck standing with one in flight. The rules are simple, but the challenge will test your brain!

Exercise your brain, improve concentration, and sharpen your mind while enjoying calm, minimalist gameplay. If you are looking for a challenge beyond simple matching and love puzzles, this memo game is for you.

## App Variants

- **memolki • fruits** — match fruit pairs (banana, apple, strawberry, and 57 more)
- **memolki • vegetables** — match vegetable pairs (tomato, carrot, broccoli, and more)
- **memolki • mammals** — match mammal pairs (lion, elephant, dolphin, and more)
- **memolki • birds** — match bird pairs (eagle, flamingo, penguin, and more)

## Key Features

- **Free to play** on Android (Google Play)
- **Offline** — no internet connection required, perfect for travel and holidays
- **Association challenge** — match pairs beyond simple identical images, using cross-sections and side views
- **Competition and multiplayer** — challenge friends, compete on the global leaderboard
- **30+ languages** — learn new words while playing
- **Minimalist design** — clean, beautiful, and distraction-free, perfect for relaxation
- **Brain training** — improve memory, concentration, logical thinking, and associative skills

## Who Is It For?

- **Toddlers (2-5 years)** — learning new concepts, recognition, and discovering the world through images
- **School Kids (6-12 years)** — excellent memory training and logical reasoning
- **Youth (13-18 years)** — maintain focus during study, relaxation between tasks
- **Adults and Teens** — intensive brain training, ideal for fans of puzzles and logic games

## Platform

Android only. Available on Google Play.
